key_points: Vast majority of headlines are options chain data (calls/puts) - pure market noise

Baidu shares rose ~2% on Nov 2 likely on broad China tech sympathy, not company-specific catalysts
No earnings, guidance, M&A, regulatory, or product launch news in the feed
Analyst ratings update (Moomoo) is routine coverage with no surprise revisions
